description: Fill absent OPTIONAL config fields with their specified defaults (Section 6.4). This isolates the defaulting layer: it does NOT perform secret-provider resolution, path/$VAR expansion, or cross-field validation (those are separate, partly I/O-bound behaviors). The given config is the flat typed-config view of Section 6.4's cheat sheet, abstracting over which of the three artifacts owns each field and, since Section 5.3.7, over which level of the operator policy config it was written at: the input is one repository's effective view, produced by resolving that repository's entry against the orchestrator-level blocks. Resolution precedes defaulting (Section 6.1) and is a separate layer, pinned by vectors/repository-inheritance.json. Only deterministic defaults are asserted; Implementation-defined defaults (for example workspace.root, agent.default_agent, agent.default_effort, codex.approval_policy, codex.thread_sandbox, codex.turn_sandbox_policy, compute.max_wall_clock_ms) are intentionally never asserted.
expect: { resolved: object }  // each dotted path in resolved MUST equal the resolved config at that path; unlisted paths are unconstrained

vectors.description: A minimal linear config resolves every deterministic default.
Fields present in the input are not overwritten by defaults.
